The shared history between Marcus and Jade is their **school magazine editing conflicts**. Jade references this directly when she says it’s “the correct move” for Marcus and Temi to write the group invite—implying that past experience has made her wary of getting pulled back into copy-editing disputes. Marcus plays on that same history by joking that Jade might edit the invite into a novel.

So their dynamic in the chat is **familiar, teasing, and mutually aware**: they trust each other enough to reference old friction lightly, and they’ve settled into roles—Marcus handles logistics, Temi handles words, and Jade gets to show up without having to edit everything. The 2023 falling-out was between Marcus and Omar, not Marcus and Jade, so that isn’t part of their shared history in this conversation.
